Hi all — technical readout and suggested schedule below.

Summary: provisioning 3 additional key groups + a low-latency analytics pod with prefix/KV caching.

Suggested rollout (estimated):
- Day 0: Amendment signed, procurement PO submitted
- Day 1-2: Issue 3 API key groups (dev-only) for integration testing
- Day 3-7: Integration & load test with dev keys; Redwood provides example batching configs and cache TTL guidance
- Day 8-12: Staging keys + enable KV cache in staging (private caching requires minimal network topology config; see checklist)
- Day 13-15: Cutover to production keys + monitoring runbook handoff

Technical questions for GridWorks:
- For the analytics pod, do you want private KV caching (private VPC peering) or shared caching? Private adds 5 business days and requires IP allowlist/peering details.
- Is the personalization microservice expecting streaming responses or short-form completions? (Impacts batching and latency targets)
- Preferred key segmentation: one key per pod vs one key per team per pod? We recommend one key per pod initially, then rotate to per-team keys after 60 days.

Attached: capacity_plan-gridworks-20270622.xlsx (capacity projection + rate-limit presets).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
